name: Funding-flip regime change — long when funding crosses from negative to positive
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (distinct from every level-based funding spec in the inbox — funding-carry-long thresholds a POSITIVE level, funding-reset-reversion a LOW/NEGATIVE level, funding-gated-momentum a level ceiling; this triggers on the SIGN-FLIP cross, a discrete regime-change event): the perp funding rate flipping from negative to positive is the moment leveraged demand returns — shorts that were being paid to be short (negative funding) capitulate and longs re-engage, marking the transition out of a washed-out, uncrowded regime into a fresh up-leg. The cross (not the level) captures the INFLECTION: early enough that funding is only just positive (carry still cheap, not yet a crowded frothy top), confirmed by price not falling. This is the funding analogue of a MACD zero-line cross — a regime-change trigger, not a state filter. Entry: funding_rate crosses UP through a fitted near-zero floor (sign flip / demand returning) AND price in a non-broken trend. Exit: funding_rate crosses DOWN back below a near-zero threshold (demand fading, regime reverting) OR price momentum rolls over — whichever fires. Disconfirmer 1: if entering on a positive funding LEVEL (gt) does as well, the cross adds no timing edge and this is funding-carry-long re-skinned. Disconfirmer 2: if an unconditional momentum long matches the deflated Sharpe, the funding flip adds nothing. Disconfirmer 3: a flip into a euphoric blow-off is the crash regime funding-contrarian-crash-filter shorts — the trend floor must keep us out of parabolic tops. Disconfirmer 4 (cost): must clear ~20bps round-trip net. tier0 funding feature (deep PIT data, 100k+ rows / 50 symbols).
catalyst: perp funding flips negative→positive — leveraged demand returns, a fresh regime up-leg
